item.title: Transgender Shooters Commit Disproportionately High Share of Mass Public and Active Shooting Attacks
item.description: Transgender Shooters Commit Disproportionately High Share of Mass Public and Active Shooting Attacks Contrary to claims by leftist “fact checkers,” such as Politfact.com, transgender individuals actually commit a disproportionately high share of mass public and active shooting attacks, new analysis by the Crime Prevention Research Center (CPRC) reveals.
